surfaces.label: Shape
surfaces.appearance: Neutral gray with gentle prepared shape shading; a display convention, not observed surface color or albedo.

surfaces.label: SPHERE photograph
surfaces.coverage: 16 deconvolved VLT/SPHERE/ZIMPOL frames, 2018-03-15 to 2018-05-05, cast onto the same MPCD mesh the Shape view uses, which is the one this body's rotation record describes. The camera's pointing and orientation are computed from that record, JPL Horizons geometry and each frame's header; the disc centre is measured in each frame. Predicted limb position angles match the observed contour to 6.11 degrees, which is the measurement floor of these frames: the disc spans about 30 pixels and is seen close to pole-on, and the scatter between consecutive exposures minutes apart is 6.62 degrees on its own, leaving no systematic part. Grayscale retains photographed illumination and matched relative frame brightness, not measured albedo. The grid marks unphotographed, grazing or rejected surface.

limits.interpretation: Trial acceptance bounds, not estimates of source accuracy.

derived.rule: A fixed contributor separation may not exceed four diagonal pixel footprints of the coarsest frame at the emission limit, plus the mesh error when the backplanes come from the archive's own shape model. A per-sample separation scales with each footprint's own range and emission. Every displayed point samples its closest source point.

photometry.formula: Original acquisition illumination retained; no photometric disk correction.
photometry.applicationLighting: Uniform flood displays the acquisition illumination; Shadows applies the existing fixed-epoch Sun bank.
photometry.limitations: No phase correction, Hapke roughness correction or cast-shadow recovery. Relative display brightness, not measured albedo.

levelMatching.interpretation: Bounded relative display-level adjustment from robust overlaps; not a phase correction or recovered albedo.

display.units: relative deconvolved intensity with original illumination; linear grayscale display

areaCoverage.method: Deterministic equal-area barycentric samples on every retained triangle; excludes atlas bleed

observation.previewPolicy: The flat preview samples unique radial intersections only; the retained triangle atlas samples the closest full-source surface point in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point; all bilinear observation contributors checked before interpolation; atlas bleed clamped to retained face.

surfaces.label: Elevation
surfaces.coverage: Closed MPCD shape from resolved VLT/SPHERE images and an ADAM starting model. Observational detail is nonuniform. The shared grid is an explicit no-imagery treatment.
